purpose: Local registry and public parcel-geometry source review. Queries were separated by English and local language. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were queried or retained.
assessment: Davanagere district administration links citizens to the state Bhoomi land-records service and identifies the local Deputy Commissioner office. State land-record / revenue-map systems are parcel-number and administrative-unit oriented; this review did not verify an anonymous geometry-only feature API for the urban WUP point. Survey of India’s city/district program inventory identifies ongoing NAKSHA urban land-record work, not an open parcel layer. No full polygon was returned; geometry presence remains unverified.
